settings.description: A JSON Schema over the settings document, so the install form has fields, not a textarea.

hooks.description: The tasks flock itself runs on the app's behalf, by the moment that fires each.

scripts.description: The Reduck scripts the app may run through the `reduck` door, as `[owner/]host/slug` addresses. A run naming any other script is refused. Empty for a release that declares none, and then the door runs nothing.

label.description: Human label for the field. Falls back to the name when the author wrote none.

description.description: Where to get the value, shown under the field. Empty when the author wrote none.

required.description: False for a secret the app can work without; the form marks the rest as needed.

page.description: Whether the page may spend this one, rather than only the app's own server-side tasks.

init.description: Runs once in an app's life, at its first page open.

newUser.description: Runs once per person, the first time they open the app.

current.description: True for the release being served, which is the one a rollback moves.

published_at.description: When the bytes were verified. Null for a release whose upload never finished.

current.description: True for the release being served, which is the one a rollback moves.

published_at.description: When the bytes were verified. Null for a release whose upload never finished.

schema_sha.description: sha256 of the `schema.sql` this release shipped. That file is the CONSOLIDATED head, run only into an app that has no database yet; an app that already has one moves by `migrations` instead.

migrations.description: The ordered migrations this release ships, applied to each app as it reaches this release.

tools.description: The tasks this release offers an agent. Empty for a release that declares none.

deployed_by.description: The handle of whoever ran the deploy, null once that account is gone or has no handle.
